title: 3.9 Jobs
unit_outcome: Introduce yourself and others in Spanish: name, age, where you are from, your job and what you have.
goal: Name jobs and say what someone does: Soy maestra. Él es doctor.
grammar_function: ¿En qué trabajas? Soy + job (no article; -o/-a for the person).
speaking_outcome: Ask and say what someone's job is.
